info.title: Aisenhub Admin API
info.description: Admin API contract. Ordinary routes require an active administrator session at AAL2. Platform Key lifecycle, Global Delete start/retry, platform-account status mutations, and Billing operator actions additionally require a server-side recent-MFA proof valid for at most 30 minutes.

503.description: MFA attestation verification is temporarily unavailable.

post.description: Prepares deletion of a verified TOTP factor for the current System Admin. The database rechecks factor ownership, membership/session state, recent MFA, the application-level factor floor, and any in-progress factor mutation; it then creates a short-lived serialized operation and invalidates all current-session recent proofs before the Provider unenroll call.

Finalizes the exact serialized MFA factor deletion operation after the Auth Provider result is known. The operation is bound to the same admin user/session/factor; successful finalization requires the verified factor to be absent before the removal audit event is written.

503.description: Identity authorization state is temporarily unavailable.

/admin/api/v1/platforms/{platformId}/acc.description: Reads the platform-scoped account workbench. The nested identity source is independently degradable: identity.source_state distinguishes available, missing, unavailable, and anonymized/not_applicable without hiding an otherwise available business workbench. Status mutations use the explicit suspend, restore, or close command endpoints.

post.description: Suspends a Platform Account. Runtime requires a non-empty reason and recent-MFA step-up.
Restores a Platform Account. Runtime requires a non-empty reason and recent-MFA step-up.
Closes a Platform Account. Runtime requires a non-empty reason and recent-MFA step-up.
Runs an idempotent Plan lifecycle command. Archive is rejected while an active Offer or a current/future non-revoked Grant still depends on the Plan.

get.description: Reads the platform Commerce policy. Product selection lives exclusively in Offer/Price/Provider Mapping, not in this policy.

patch.description: Updates purchase pause and subscription presentation copy with optimistic concurrency.

get.description: Lists platform Offers with their latest Price and Provider Mapping readiness.

post.description: Activates or archives an Offer with a reason and idempotent operation id.
Creates the next immutable draft Price version for an Offer.
Publishes or independently retires an immutable Price version. Commands are idempotent by operation_id and serialized on the Offer scope.
Atomically switches the current Price-scoped Provider Mapping or disables the target Mapping, with a reason and idempotent operation id.

get.description: Stable server-side cursor/filter list of entitlement accounts with winning Grant attribution.
Stable Campaign list with server-side filters and redemption statistics.
Lists masked Redemption code state and redeemed account attribution; plaintext and HMAC are never returned.

patch.description: Updates legacy account file policy fields. max_platform_total_bytes is the global platform physical capacity; when supplied it requires Admin step-up.

get.description: Returns bounded commerce metrics using verified settlement, compensated refund and current winning Grant facts; values are not MRR/ARR or accounting revenue.

post.description: Queues a provider requery. The resulting job keeps its bounded retry budget and may enter manual_review with a classified failure for operator action.

get.description: Business-readable Config resource pool. Platform filtering and Gallery status filtering are applied server-side before cursor pagination.
Authoritative pending Config Gallery review queue for one platform.

post.description: Approve or reject one pending immutable Version. Approval is the only action that switches the Gallery published Version.
Remove, restore, or block Gallery visibility without deleting the author-owned Config.

get.description: Platform-scoped Feedback processing list. Structured filters are applied server-side before stable cursor pagination.
Generate CSV on the server from selected Feedback ids or the complete server-side filter result. At most 100 selected ids and 5000 exported rows.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated Feedback UUIDs; omit to export the full filter result.

get.description: Read one submitted Feedback item including protected contact snapshot, attachment metadata and processing timeline.
Stream an authorized Feedback image from the dedicated private Storage bucket. No public object URL is returned.

post.description: Request privacy-first deletion for 1-100 submitted Feedback items. Personal data is minimized before asynchronous attachment cleanup.

MfaAttestation.name: X-Mfa-Attestation
MfaAttestation.description: Short-lived server-signed attestation created by the Admin BFF only after Supabase MFA verification.

AuditActor.name: actor
AuditActor.description: Matches actor type, actor UUID, trusted platform-profile display name, or current Auth email.

AuditPlatformId.name: platform_id
AuditPlatformId.description: Exact authoritative platform scope recorded on the audit event.

AuditOutcome.name: outcome
AuditOutcome.description: Exact recorded outcome. The reserved value unrecorded selects events whose audit metadata does not contain an outcome fact.

BillingCursor.name: cursor
BillingCursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page. It binds created_at and order_id for stable pagination.

BillingOrder.description: Billing order detail with an ordered, read-only evidence timeline.

BillingObservability.description: Read-only Billing queue, reconciliation, scheduler, refund-observation, and alert delivery observability.

AdminSecurityStatus.description: Current Admin assurance and active recent MFA proof.

IdentityDetail.description: Live Auth identity with platform associations and the authoritative AisenHub deletion lifecycle projection.

PlatformOverview.description: Authoritative per-platform operational summary for a fixed 7, 30, or 90 day period and its adjacent previous period.

Object.description: JSON response with data and request_id.

Page.description: Cursor page with data, next_cursor, and request_id.

StepUpRequired.description: A server-side recent-MFA proof bound to the current Admin session and valid for at most 30 minutes is required.

PreconditionFailed.description: The configuration changed after the client read it.

PreconditionRequired.description: If-Match is required for this mutation.
